<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
    <title>Color Changer</title>
</head>
<body>
    <canvas id="colorCanvas"></canvas>
    <script>
        const canvas = document.getElementById('colorCanvas');
        const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
        const key = 'c';
        let colorIndex = 0;

        document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
            if (e.key === '0') {
                // FACT line 14: colorIndex is declared `let`.
                // FACT line 18: existing code writes it as colorIndex = (colorIndex + 1) % 3;
// on this key: every piece of state is back to its starting value.
                colorIndex = 0;
                ctx.fillStyle = `rgb(${colorIndex * 100}, ${colorIndex * 100}, ${colorIndex * 100})`;
                ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
            }
            if (e.key === key) {
                colorIndex = (colorIndex + 1) % 3;
                ctx.fillStyle = `rgb(${colorIndex * 100}, ${colorIndex * 100}, ${colorIndex * 100})`;
                ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
            }
        });

        window.app = { state: () => ({ colorIndex }) };
    </script>
</body>
</html>
